record.field: Privilege: an incident hears how the runs working for it end and the pull requests they open

Taken whenever a run working for an incident ends or its pull request is linked, by whoever ends it (the runner's service user, the lease reaper, an administrator): the incident's chatter hears how a run working for it ended, and the pull request of the branch the run pushed learns its incident and is followed there. Every write is logged.
